email.body1:
Hanne, saw Solidus locked in surveillance partnerships with Webull, Kalshi, and B2C2, with HALO now monitoring over a trillion trading events a day.

That enterprise momentum usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can work, and reps end up buried in research instead of conversations. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Solidus off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:

With marquee logos landing, most revenue ops leaders do not actually know how many meetings the team needs to book to keep that pace across the next wave of accounts. The gap shows up late, and by then the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Solidus needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Solidus's reply rate likely compares to other fintech and compliance vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
